variants.title: p-n diode: forward I-V of a 1N4001 silicon rectifier
variants.note: A 1 A, 50 V silicon rectifier of the same family as the 1N4007. Shockley parameters from its SPICE model.

variants.title: p-n diode: forward I-V of a 1N4148 small-signal diode
variants.note: A small glass-bodied silicon diode used in signal and logic circuits; its black band marks the cathode.

variants.title: p-n diode: forward I-V of a germanium diode
variants.unknown: the knee voltage of the germanium diode
variants.note: Germanium has a smaller band gap than silicon, so its saturation current is about a thousand times larger and the knee comes at about 0.2-0.3 V instead of 0.6-0.7 V.

source.title: NCERT Physics Part II, Class XII, Ch 14: barrier potential about 0.2 V for Ge and 0.7 V for Si
source.note: Is = 2 µA and n = 1.3 are typical of a germanium point-contact diode, not a property of a named product.

variants.title: p-n diode: forward I-V of a 1N5819 Schottky diode
variants.unknown: the knee voltage of the Schottky diode
variants.note: A metal-semiconductor junction rather than p-n: it starts conducting at about 0.2-0.3 V and switches fast, so it is used in power supplies.

source.title: 1N5817-1N5819 Schottky rectifier datasheet (forward voltage curve)
source.note: Is and n chosen to follow the typical forward curve (about 0.2 V at 10 mA, 0.45 V at 1 A).

variants.title: LED: forward I-V of a red LED
variants.unknown: the knee voltage of the red LED
variants.note: A light-emitting diode is a p-n junction in a wider band-gap semiconductor: it needs about 1.8-2.0 V before it conducts, and it glows as the current flows.

source.title: Kingbright L-53HD (5 mm red LED) datasheet: forward voltage 2.0 V typical at 20 mA
source.note: n = 2 assumed; Is chosen so that V = 2.0 V at 20 mA.

variants.title: LED: forward I-V of a yellow LED
variants.unknown: the knee voltage of the yellow LED
variants.note: Yellow light has a shorter wavelength than red, so the band gap and the knee voltage are a little higher.

source.title: Kingbright L-53YD (5 mm yellow LED) datasheet: forward voltage 2.1 V typical at 20 mA
source.note: n = 2 assumed; Is chosen so that V = 2.1 V at 20 mA.

variants.title: LED: forward I-V of a green LED
variants.unknown: the knee voltage of the green LED
variants.note: A gallium phosphide green LED: its knee voltage is higher again than the yellow and red ones.

source.title: Kingbright L-53GD (5 mm green LED) datasheet: forward voltage 2.2 V typical at 20 mA
source.note: n = 2 assumed; Is chosen so that V = 2.2 V at 20 mA.

variants.title: LED: forward I-V of a blue LED
variants.unknown: the knee voltage of the blue LED
variants.note: Blue light needs the widest band gap of the four colours, so a blue LED needs about 3 V or more before it conducts.

source.title: Typical 5 mm InGaN blue LED datasheet: forward voltage 3.2-3.4 V at 20 mA
source.note: Generic blue LED: n = 2.6 assumed; Is chosen so that V = 3.3 V at 20 mA.
